Policies

Terms of service, privacy, deposits and the cancellation policy that apply to every Scottsdale Sprinters reservation.

Last updated September 2026

At a glance

50% deposit. Holds the vehicle. The balance is charged to the card on file two days before pickup. Free cancellation. 14 days out on a standard trip, 30 days on a group of 20 or more. Tax only, 8%. No booking fee, no service charge, no fuel surcharge. Gratuity is optional.

Terms of service: 1. Acceptance of terms

By booking transportation with Scottsdale Sprinters you agree to these terms. If you do not agree to them, please do not book.

Terms of service: 2. What we provide

Chauffeured ground transportation: airport transfers, corporate travel, weddings and celebrations, day trips and private charters, in the vehicles listed on the fleet page. Bottled water is on board for every ride and it is the only complimentary amenity; anything else is an add-on you choose at checkout.

Terms of service: 3. Pricing

Every price we quote is before tax. Arizona sales tax of 8% is added at checkout. There is no service charge and no booking fee, and gratuity is optional and never added for you. Published rates hold except on the short list of major event dates published in advance. Rates and minimums for each vehicle are on the pricing page.

Terms of service: 4. Deposits and balance

A 50% deposit confirms the reservation and holds the vehicle. The remaining balance is charged automatically to the card on file two days before pickup. A card that declines may cost you the reservation, so tell us in advance if it needs to be replaced.

Terms of service: 5. House rules and fees

The full house rules are on the ride rules page. Two of them carry a fee: Smoking or vaping, $1,500. The smell does not leave the cabin, so the vehicle comes off the road. Excessive spills or a biohazard clean, $450. Minor spills are never charged; a deep clean after someone is sick is $450. Passengers are expected to treat the chauffeur and the vehicle with respect. Illegal substances and drinking under 21 are prohibited, and the chauffeur may end a trip that becomes unsafe.

Terms of service: 6. Damage authorization

You accept the vehicle in the condition it is in at pickup; tell your chauffeur straight away if anything is wrong. Your chauffeur photographs the interior before every trip for our internal records. You authorize us to charge the card on file for damage beyond normal use. We never charge for damage without showing you the photographs first.

Terms of service: 7. Our guarantee

If the vehicle at pickup isn’t the one you booked, the ride is free. Not discounted, not credited — free.

Terms of service: 8. Liability

We carry commercial insurance on every vehicle. We are not liable for delays caused by traffic, weather or anything else outside our control, and personal belongings left in a vehicle remain your responsibility — though we will always try to get them back to you.

Terms of service: 9. Changes to these terms

We may update these terms. The date at the top of this tab tells you when they last moved, and the terms in force are the ones published when you booked. Questions: reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com.

Privacy policy: What we collect

What a trip needs and nothing else: your name, email and phone number, the pickup and dropoff addresses, your trip details, and payment information. We do not sell any of it.

Privacy policy: What we use it for

Confirming and running your trip, reaching you about it, invoicing it, and — only if you have agreed — telling you about an offer. That is the whole list.

Privacy policy: Who else sees it

Four processors help us run the business, and each sees only the part it needs: Our payment processor, Stripe, takes the payment. Card numbers go straight to Stripe and never touch our systems. Our hosting and database provider stores the website and the reservation records. Our reservations CRM is where our team works your booking, and the system that sends our text messages. Our email delivery provider sends confirmations, invoices and reminders. Ask us and we will name any of them. Beyond those four, we share information only when the law requires it.

Privacy policy: Text messages

Giving us your mobile number means we may text you about your reservation: confirmations, the chauffeur’s arrival, and anything that changes on the day. Marketing texts are separate and go out only if you opt in. Reply STOP to any message to stop them, or HELP for help. Message and data rates may apply, and we never sell or share your number for anyone else’s marketing.

Privacy policy: How long we keep it

Reservation and payment records are kept for seven years, because tax and insurance rules require it. Marketing contact details are deleted when you unsubscribe. Anything else is deleted once it no longer serves the trip it was collected for.

Privacy policy: Security

Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and payments are processed through PCI-compliant systems. Only the people who need a record can open it.

Privacy policy: Your rights

Ask us for a copy of what we hold, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com and we will answer within thirty days.

Privacy policy: Cookies

The site uses cookies to keep you signed in and to understand which pages people use. Your browser settings control them.

Cancellation policy

Every reservation is held with a 50% deposit; the balance is charged two days before pickup. The short version: cancel 14 days out and you get everything back; inside 14 days you lose the deposit.

Cancellation policy: Standard trips

SUVs and single-vehicle Sprinter bookings — airport, point-to-point or hourly. 14 or more days before pickup: full refund — no fee, no questions. Between 72 hours and 14 days: we keep the 50% deposit and refund the rest. Inside 72 hours, or a no-show: we can’t refund, because the vehicle has been off the market for you.

Cancellation policy: Large groups and party buses

Any booking of 20 or more passengers, two or more vehicles, or a wedding. 30 or more days out: full refund. Between 14 and 30 days: we keep the deposit and refund the rest. Inside 14 days, or a no-show: no refund.

Cancellation policy: Major-event dates

Barrett-Jackson, the WM Phoenix Open, spring-training weekends, Super Bowl week when it is in the Valley, New Year’s Eve and prom weekends (Fridays and Saturdays in April and May). These are the dates we turn other people away for, so: 30 or more days out: we refund the balance and keep the deposit. Inside 30 days, or a no-show: no refund. Most Scottsdale operators make these dates non-refundable the moment you book. We don’t.

Cancellation policy: Need to move it instead?

Ask us 72 or more hours ahead and we’ll move your date once, free, subject to availability — your deposit comes with you and the new date’s rate applies. That’s usually the better call. Inside 72 hours a date change is treated as a cancellation. Time, pickup address and vehicle changes are handled by the reservations team at any time, subject to availability.

Cancellation policy: If we cancel

Weather, mechanical, anything on our side — you get 100% back or a free reschedule. Your choice.

Cancellation policy: How to cancel

Use the cancellation link in your confirmation email, text (480) 771-4719, call (480) 771-4719, or email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com.

Cancellation policy: Refund processing

Refunds are issued within 3 to 5 business days. Your bank may take another 5 to 10 business days to show it.
